name: Pia Carrot G.O. Toybox 2 ~Spring Fair~
original_name: ぴあきゃろG.O. TOYBOX2 ～スプリングフェア～

Contains 4 mini adventures:
-Rumi no Engage Ring
-Kanae to Sana no Kyuujitsu
-Yamana Kaede wa Otoshigoro

translation:

- 愛是燃燒的友情
